name: Orange Blossoms
source:
"Orange you glad I didn't say banana?"

"Spring isn't even the season for oranges... is it?"

"Wait so are cats lactose intolerant or not?"

[From [url=https://no-xiruo.itch.io/orange-blossoms]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“我没说香蕉，你是不是高兴‘橘’了？”

“春天根本不是橘子的季节……对吧？”

“等等，所以猫到底有没有乳糖不耐受啊？”
